objective: Make the Engineering Regression Gate cover shared AdMob runtime gates and enforce isolated workstream changed-path allowlists.
productionBaselineEvidence: PR #494 merged at 0d2d05d565a397158b8f05118c151caef692a299 after Engineering Accountability, Performance R1 QA and Main integration QA passed. Production telemetry on 2026-11-04 PH records 91 requests, 28 loads, 9 impressions and 40 failures across 8 Android sessions. No OTA from this revision is asserted as live.
chosenApproach: Classify all shared AdMob request-gate, viewport, unit, policy, telemetry, diagnostics, placement, opportunity, hook and renderer modules as ads-monetization risk. Enforce the scope manifest allowedPaths against every changed path except the manifest itself.
selectionRationale: The previous source classifier omitted shared ad controller modules, so edits to the actual request gates could bypass mandatory ads-specific regression coverage. The allowlist was documented but not enforced.
alternativeApproaches: Keep the narrow component-only source classifier and rely on developer memory; rejected because shared gate edits can bypass focused coverage.
Require every ads test for all source changes; rejected because it adds unrelated CI cost and coupling.
Explicitly classify ad runtime modules and validate each isolated scope allowlist; selected.
preserveBehaviors: Do not change AdMob request behavior, UMP consent, SDK initialization, remote kill switches, route safety, shared cooldown or placements.
Do not alter native package identity, runtime version, app/unit IDs or production OTA workflow.
Preserve focused regression execution and fail-closed behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Shared ad controller, viewport, units, policy, telemetry, diagnostics and opportunity modules trigger ads-monetization coverage.
Android, shared and web ad renderers trigger ads-monetization coverage.
An unrelated test cannot satisfy ads-monetization coverage.
A changed file omitted from allowedPaths fails with a path-specific diagnostic.
Focused engineering regression tests and Engineering Accountability pass.
No production OTA or runtime behavior changes are made by this gate-only patch.
